summary.headline: Horary Topics and Camaterus Excerpt
summary.text: Catalog entries 114–130 cover horary and astrological topics including house changes, parental death, inception, ascensions and declinations, planetary configurations, inheritance, epilepsy, robbery, sowing, imprisonment, a dated eclipse, lunar applications, and lunar effects. Chapter 130 begins excerpts from the astrological poem of Iohannes Camaterus in fifteen-syllable political verses.
